headline: Anderson held at Wingate but still unbeaten
dek: Anderson were held to a draw at Wingate on Saturday, their third of the season alongside six wins and no defeats, twenty-two scored and ten conceded. Catawba, also unbeaten, have a match in hand on them in the conference table, and the two do not meet until the middle of October.
displaced_by: Anderson's draw at Wingate; the standing dek's goal figures no longer hold

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Catawba have scored twenty-two and conceded three, and no one player has more than Alex Payton's four of those goals.

wire.line: Every side in the conference has now won at least once; Lenoir-Rhyne's first came at Newberry on Saturday.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six matches whose dates have passed carry no result: Newberry's opener at Converse, and the rest of them Emory & Henry's, from late August to mid-September.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lenoir-Rhyne's win at Newberry on Saturday was their first of the season: one win, three draws and five defeats, twelve scored and twenty-one conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Emory & Henry beat Coker at home on Saturday for a second win in succession and lead the conference table with two wins and two draws, nine scored and four conceded.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Catawba have conceded three goals across five wins and two draws, and have not lost.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Wingate's Cole Freeman has made thirty-three saves and conceded seven goals.

last_match.line: Lenoir-Rhyne's first win of the season; Newberry have lost their last two.

next_match.line: Catawba have yet to lose; Tusculum have not won since early September.
